message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant bought rights to harvest forest from a company, then hired a chainsaw operator to cut trees beyond the permitted area, exceeding the license. He sold timber. This is illegal logging without proper permit, exceeding scope. The label list includes "滥伐林木" (illegal overcutting) and "盗伐林木" (illegal logging). In examples, similar case: first example about cutting without permit, they labeled "滥伐林木". Another example about cutting 113 trees, also "滥伐林木". So this case is similar: unauthorized cutting beyond license. So charge: 滥伐林木.

Also possibly "非法占用农用地"? Not here. He didn't occupy land, just cut trees. So single charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]滥伐林木<eoa>
